settings.tunnelingHint: Can make 4K play more smoothly on some TVs. Turn it off if the picture or sound stutters.
audio.desktopNote: On this computer the effects change the tone only. The levelling of Night mode and Loud and clear, and the centre-channel dialogue boost, work on Android and Google TV.
audio.passthrough: This audio goes to your TV or receiver still encoded (Dolby or DTS), so the effects can't change it. To use them, turn off surround sound passthrough in the device's sound settings.
